Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in medical device development, MedTech innovation, healthcare technology translation, biomedical engineering, digital health, AI-enabled healthcare technologies, startup incubation, or translational research, with at least 3 years of experience in project leadership, programme management, or institutional research. Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience in research, project management, data management, monitoring & evaluation, or implementation of health research projects.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Bathinda Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Bathinda to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bathinda recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Bathinda recruitment is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Head and Project Coordinator posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 for Project Head (Senior Scientist) and 1 for Project Coordinator (Technical Support).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Head (Senior Scientist)?
faq.answer: The qualification required is MBBS, BDS, B.E./B.Tech., MBA, or an equivalent degree in specified engineering, management, or science disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Coordinator (Technical Support) position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Project Coordinator (Technical Support) position is not exceeding 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Project Head (Senior Scientist) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Head (Senior Scientist) post is ₹1,50,000/- per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Application Screening, Online Screening Interview, and a Final In-Person Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum post-qualification experience required for Project Coordinator (Technical Support)?
faq.answer: A minimum of 1 year of post-qualification experience in research, project management, or data management is required.

faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
